comment: The weather of the first dungeon: dust motes that fall and settle (D-187, D-202). Each mote starts across the view, it falls a little, and the damping stops it. It then lies on the ground for 5 seconds, and it goes out. The scene light falls on the motes, so a mote shows inside a pool of torchlight and stays dark outside one (D-183). The view is 640 by 360 art pixels, and each x and y comes from its north-west corner (D-842). PR-17 gives the first places their own weather (D-520).
